name: cx.lkj/short-links
title: LKJ — free URL shortener
description: Shorten public URLs for free with 24-hour expiry and a four-digit code for TV browsers.

tools.name: create_short_link
tools.description: Create a free short link to share in a message, email or anywhere you can paste a URL. Returns the complete versioned URL and exact expiry 24 hours after creation, plus a four-digit code and instructions for TV use. Only submit public, non-sensitive URLs the user wants to share; codes are guessable. Use a fresh random UUID request_id per logical request and repeat the same ID and URL for retries. Limits: 20 new attempts per network per UTC day within 200 service-wide across all creation methods.

url.description: The public website the user wants to share. Bare domains default to HTTPS. Never submit private URLs or access tokens.

request_id.description: Generate a fresh random UUID for a new logical request. Retain it and the exact URL for retries. This is a request identifier, not an API key.

tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Read what LKJ does, whether new agent links are currently enabled, its fair-use limits and when to choose four-digit temporary links. Does not create or open a code, check a destination or consume a creation allowance.
